meta.name: meta-ads
meta.description: Manage Meta Ads (Facebook + Instagram) — performance, ROAS, CPM, frequency, audience overlap, learning phase, creative fatigue, budgets, ad sets, campaigns, ads. Use for any mention of Meta Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, ROAS, CPM, ad spend, or campaign settings on Meta.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Meta 广告投放与效果优化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 Facebook 或 Instagram 上投放广告并需要管理投放效果。
copy.tagline_en: Manage Meta Ads performance and optimization
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run ads on Facebook or Instagram and need to manage campaign performance.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会分析 Meta 广告(Facebook+Instagram)的投放数据,按基准评估 ROAS、CPM、频次、学习阶段等指标,指出创意疲劳和人群重叠等问题,并在你批准后执行暂停广告组、改预算、重命名等操作,同时记录账号基线用于异常检测。
howto.when: 当用户提到「Meta 广告」「Facebook 广告」「ROAS」等词,或要求看投放表现、改预算、暂停广告时触发。

say.note: Claude 会拉数据并解读趋势

say.text: 这个广告组是不是创意疲劳了?怎么办?
say.note: 会查频次、CPM和CTR判断疲劳并给建议

say.text: 把ROAS最低的广告组预算调低20%
say.note: 先展示当前值、新值和影响,确认后才改

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude analyzes Meta Ads: benchmarks ROAS/CPM/frequency/learning phase, flags creative fatigue/audience overlap. With approval, it can pause ad sets, change budgets, rename campaigns, and keeps a baseline for anomaly detection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "Meta ads", "Facebook ads", "ROAS", etc., or ask to review performance, adjust budgets, or pause campaigns.

say_en.text: Check our ROAS and CPM trend over the last 7 days.
say_en.note: Claude pulls the data and explains the trend.

say_en.text: Is this ad set in creative fatigue? What should we do?
say_en.note: Checks frequency, CPM, and CTR to judge fatigue and advise.

say_en.text: Lower the budget of the ad set with the worst ROAS by 20%.
say_en.note: Shows values and impact, then changes after confirmation.
